name: Durlax Top Surface Ltd.
summary: Durlax Top Surface Ltd. is an India-based manufacturer specializing in premium solid surface materials for diverse interior and exterior applications. The company primarily operates within the home improvement and building materials sector, offering products such as acrylic solid surfaces, modified acrylic sheets, AASA Laminates, and Zinc Surfaces (DLZINC). Its product portfolio includes brands like LUXOR, which offers Acrylic UV Solid Surfaces, ASPIRON, which provides modified solid surfaces, and HERONITEZ, known for luxury acrylic solid surfaces. These materials are characterized by seamless designs, antibacterial properties, and fire-retardant features, emphasizing durability, aesthetics, and ease of use. Durlax Top Surface Ltd. targets residential, commercial, hospitality, and healthcare sectors, supplying materials for countertops, flooring, and wall cladding. The company distributes its products through an extensive network across India and exports to international markets including Dubai, the USA, Mexico, Greece, Nepal, Qatar, and Sri Lanka.
